site.name: Shirley Claw
site.tagline: Tiny web tools, toys and odd experiments.
site.description: Free little web apps by Shirley Claw: useful tools, fun toys and random experiments that run right in your browser. No sign-up, no install.

sections.title: Useful
sections.blurb: Tools that actually do a job.

sections.title: Fun
sections.blurb: Toys and games for wasting time well.

apps.title: Plonk
apps.seoTitle: Plonk — Free Online Floor Planner (No Sign-up)
apps.tagline: Draw a room, plonk in furniture, see if the sofa fits.
apps.description: Plonk is the quickest way to throw a floor plan together: type room sizes, drop in beds, sofas and kitchen units, export PNG or SVG. Free, in your browser, no sign-up, no fuss.

apps.title: Elfless
apps.seoTitle: Elfless — Free Secret Santa Name Draw (No Sign-up, No Emails)
apps.tagline: Type names, press Draw, send everyone their own secret link.
apps.description: Elfless draws Secret Santa names in your browser: type everyone in, keep couples from drawing each other, add a budget or date, then send each person a private link that reveals only their match. Free, no accounts, no emails, nothing stored online.

apps.title: Elbowroom
apps.seoTitle: Elbowroom — Free Seating Chart Maker (No Sign-up)
apps.tagline: Type your guests, keep feuding uncles apart, get a seating chart.
apps.description: Elbowroom makes a wedding or party seating chart in seconds: list guests, keep couples and families together, keep rivals apart, set table sizes, then swap seats by clicking and print. Free, in your browser, no sign-up.

apps.title: Tearoff
apps.seoTitle: Tearoff — Free Photo Calendar Maker, Printable A4 (No Sign-up)
apps.tagline: Photo wall, desk flip & tear-off calendars to print on A4.
apps.description: Tearoff makes printable A4 calendars with your own photos: photo wall calendar, desk flip cards, a tear-off daily pad, weekly and monthly planners, a year poster or a year at a glance. 12 styles, 20 languages, Monday or Sunday start, your birthdays written into the days. Free, in your browser; photos never leave your device.
